topic: Saltwater crocodile record bite force and weak jaw-opening muscles
title: Saltwater Crocodile: The Strongest Bite Ever Measured
description:
A 2012 study measured the saltwater crocodile bite at about 3,700 psi, the strongest recorded in a living animal. See why its bite is so powerful and where it is weak.

#crocodile #bitepower #animals #shorts

es.description:
Un estudio de 2012 midió la mordida del cocodrilo marino en unos 3.700 psi, la más fuerte registrada en un animal vivo. Descubre por qué es tan potente y dónde es débil.

scenes.narration: A saltwater crocodile bit down at about 3,700 pounds per square inch in a 2012 study, the strongest bite ever recorded in a living animal.

visual.prompt: a large saltwater crocodile with its jaws open in murky water, close shot

scenes.narration: A human bite is only around one hundred and fifty pounds per square inch, so the crocodile bites roughly twenty times harder.

visual.prompt: a close view of a crocodile mouth full of conical teeth against a dark river background

scenes.narration: Its jaws are packed with powerful closing muscles, and its conical teeth are built to grip and hold, not to chew.

visual.prompt: the conical teeth of a crocodile lined along a closed jaw, sharp detail

scenes.narration: An adult can reach about five meters in length and weigh over a tonne, and it ambushes prey from the water's edge.

visual.prompt: a crocodile lurking just below the surface with only its eyes showing, dusk light

scenes.narration: Yet the muscles that open its jaw are surprisingly weak. A strong person could reportedly hold a smaller crocodile's mouth shut with their hands.

visual.prompt: a crocodile resting on a riverbank with its mouth closed, side view

scenes.narration: Scores: bite force, crocodile 10. Opening strength, crocodile 3. Ambush skill, crocodile 9.

visual.prompt: a dark background with a glowing crocodile outline and three score bars

scenes.narration: So the strongest bite on Earth has a hidden weakness. Which animal do you think comes closest to it?
